title: get_changes_since_for_chat doc omits TOCTOU warning for callers
description: The new doc comment says 'The caller is responsible for reading the current state separately if needed.' It does not warn that reading state in a separate lock acquisition creates a window where messages can be written between the two calls, making new_state inconsistent with the returned IDs. Any caller that reads new_state in a different lock scope from get_changes_since_for_chat is silently exposed to this hazard. The doc should state the constraint explicitly: 'new_state MUST be read atomically in the same lock scope as this call; reading it in a separate lock scope allows intervening writes to produce a new_state that does not match the returned IDs.'
